idea-plugin.name: LatherIt
idea-plugin.description:
LatherIt is a fast, modern client for SOAP and REST services - an alternative to SoapUI, right inside your IDE. Open a *.latherit.yaml project file and it shows up as a LatherIt editor.

The LatherIt user interface is available in English and German and follows the language of the IDE. It can be changed in LatherIt's settings.

Features

  • Import WSDLs, generate sample requests, send them and inspect the response.
  • Import OpenAPI/Swagger (JSON or YAML) as REST services with parameters and sample bodies - also from URLs that need a login.
  • REST requests with query, path, matrix and header parameters; paste a cURL command to create one, copy any sent request as cURL.
  • Environments (e.g. dev, staging, live) that override project properties; the active one is chosen per computer, not stored in the project file.
  • Test suites with assertions, property transfers and scripts (JavaScript).
  • Hex view for binary responses.
  • Mock services for SOAP and REST, running inside the IDE while the editor tab is open.
  • Authentication: Basic, Bearer, Digest and NTLM.
  • Property expansion like SoapUI (${#Project#name}, ${#Env#NAME}, inline scripts).
  • Import SoapUI projects.
  • Tabs, breadcrumb navigation and Go to (Cmd+P / Ctrl+P) across all open projects; Board and Collections for the requests you use most.
  • Project files are plain YAML, made for version control, and saved automatically like any other file in the IDE.
  • HTTPS trusts the certificates of your operating system, like your browser does.
  • Optional sidebar module: the tree as a tool window next to Project, each request in its own editor tab (per project, Settings | Tools | LatherIt).

Usage

  • File | New | LatherIt Project creates a project file, File | New | LatherIt Project from SoapUI… imports a SoapUI project (*-soapui-project.xml).
  • Open any *.latherit.yaml (or .yml) file: the LatherIt tab shows the client, the Text tab the YAML.
